laura-ops: Heads-up: Quantum X100 dedicated pools will open a limited validation window in montreal-2 and sao-paulo-4 on 2026-08-20 10:00 UTC. This is a preview for integration testing only. Do NOT move production workloads yet.

dong-eng: Quick spec check? memory and expected perf vs H100v2?

laura-ops: X100 = 64GB VRAM, ultra-low-latency interconnect, sparse kernels enabled. Early internal runs show FP16 latency ~0.8x H100v2 for short-context, but throughput on long sequences is similar. Numbers provisional.

infra-bot: System notice: pools/quantum-x100 labelled "preview-rotational". Warm-window default = 75m. Preemptible cap = 30% of pool. Placement priority: reserved contracts > committed buckets > warm reservations > ad-hoc. Policy: preview pools do not accept priority guarantees. See intranet/policies/dedicated-preview (internal).

nora-sre: Oncall/runbook: X100 racks have updated BMC firmware pinned to 4.1.2 for preview. If you see IPMI/BMC anomalies tag @nora-sre and escalate to #eng-oncall. Runbook: intranet.redwood/runbooks/quantum-x100.

ethan-product: Billing tag for tracking?

laura-ops: Use charge tag: quantum-preview-aug2026 in reservation metadata. Console filter will appear by EOD.

laura-ops: CLI snippet:
# reserve 1 GPU in quantum-x100 pool in montreal-2 for 90 minutes starting 2026-08-20T10:00Z
rdrctl reserve --pool quantum-x100 --region montreal-2 --count 1 --start 2026-08-20T10:00Z --duration 90m --meta "charge=quantum-preview-aug2026"

dong-eng: Reserving one for quick smoke. Will post perf notes in #eng-runtime.

infra-bot: Reservation confirmed (id: 52567) for dong-eng — pool: quantum-x100, region: montreal-2, start: 2026-08-20T10:00Z, duration: 90m.

legal-bot: Reminder: preview pools are NOT approved for regulated customer data until compliance clears the region. Do not process PHI/PCI.

laura-ops: If you find any anomalies open a ticket with label "quantum-x100-preview" and paste traces here. We'll monitor metrics and pause the window if needed. Thanks team :rocket:
